title: Anchor for VP07. A standing figure at the origin, framed head-and-shoulders at 40 deg FOV.
note: Named states double as the viewpoint anchors in tools/harness/viewpoints.json: shoot.mjs calls loadState(viewpoint.anchor) before posing the camera, so every anchor id MUST be a loadable state or the viewpoint is unshootable and the metric it feeds scores 0, fail-closed (HARNESS.md §6). This state also toggles the npcShowcase prop group, which is the figure itself.
